catalog.format: rebuildable JSON index plus immutable per-profile references
catalog.authority: NONE; externally provisioned public roots; existing inspector receipt and manager approval only
catalog.supported_evidence: A_RESUME_V1 signed real cost receipt; exactly SERIAL/W6 five observations per method
catalog.test_evidence: existing governance OFFLINE_CONTRACT_ONLY profiles; never current real performance
catalog.deduplication: profile id and session sha plus goal; duplicate profiles do not add confidence
catalog.index_integrity: STOP on mismatch; explicit rebuild preserves originals; index grants no approval
catalog.normal_lookup: exact problem key dictionary lookup; load/hash selected references and signed raw dependencies only
catalog.audit: registration/rebuild separate; no full archive scan per request

routes.platform: Linux only in V0; other operating systems and heterogeneous core classes not qualified
routes.unknown_topology: REFUSED; partial core identification does not qualify parallel routes
routes.quota: explicit quota observation required: observed finite positive or observed unlimited
routes.W6: six distinct physical cores; main CPU equals last worker CPU
routes.W3_W4: candidate plans only; learning service connection NOT_IMPLEMENTED
routes.selection: CPU_MIN SERIAL; no current manager-approved session snapshot -> SERIAL; W3/W4 never auto activated

current_performance: OBSERVED_REAL; exact session digest; exact env id; exact problem key; existing manager owns snapshot profile and chooses it; no conversion by model name or env id
study: reuse existing knowledge.value; conservative benefit lower bound; supplied verified baseline; expected reuses/budget/risk required; execution_authorized always false

benchmark.measurement_scope: synthetic key search only; full selected evidence verification measured separately; not physics performance
benchmark.environment: approved Linux offline process, one permitted CPU, record platform/Python/CPU/affinity/quota before benchmark

offline.expected_tests: static expansion stored in code_seal.json; actual JUnit required
offline.fail_error_skip: STOP; preserve outputs; at most three attempts without budget reset
offline.authorization: fresh human approval, pinned source/protocol, outside-guest guardian required; no local dynamic tests
